pages.intent: the decision asked of the board and the eight commitments behind it
pages.message: Corrin 2028 adds $104m of EBITDA and releases $146m of working capital by FY2028; the board is asked to approve the programme, two plant exits and the $165m it costs

exhibits.reader_must_see: each of eight operating measures today and the FY2028 target it commits to, with the page that proves it
exhibits.comparison: each measure's FY2025 baseline against its FY2028 target
exhibits.data: eight measures in mixed units, each with a baseline, a target and a change, stated at the precision each measure is managed to

forms_considered.form: KPI tiles with target, baseline and change
forms_considered.reason: chosen: eight unlike units cannot share an axis, and a tile gives each its own figure and change

forms_considered.form: one table of measures by year
forms_considered.reason: carries the figures but reads as an appendix on the page a director opens first

forms_considered.form: slope chart of baseline to target
forms_considered.reason: mixed units would need eight scales, so the slopes compare nothing

exhibits.chosen_form: KPI tiles with target, baseline and change
exhibits.why: the summary page is read first and fast; a target per tile with its baseline beside it answers what we commit to without arithmetic
exhibits.marks: the target figure large in petrol; the change in bold petrol over the FY2025 baseline in grey; four bars on one scale per tile, FY2025 grey, the FY2026 and FY2027 interim targets light petrol and FY2028 petrol, each with its value; the owner and the initiatives that deliver it at the foot; each tile names its proof page

exhibits.reader_must_see: where in the pack each part of the case is proved
exhibits.comparison: each page against its subject
exhibits.data: seven pages, each with a number and a one-line subject

forms_considered.reason: chosen: directors refer to pages by number in the meeting
loses the page numbers that the tiles point to

exhibits.why: it ties the tiles' page references to the pages and gives the pack its order
exhibits.marks: page numbers in bold petrol

exhibits.reader_must_see: what the programme costs in each year and when cumulative cash turns positive
exhibits.comparison: cost against net cash, year by year
exhibits.data: two cost lines and their total over three years, then net and cumulative cash

forms_considered.reason: chosen: five rows of figures the audit chair checks
the cash turn needs the cumulative line, which a table states exactly

exhibits.why: the approval is for money, so its phasing sits beside the ask
exhibits.marks: the cost total and cumulative cash bold; 2027, where cash turns positive, in petrol

pages.intent: where value and cash leak in the order-to-cash cycle today
pages.message: Order-to-cash takes 70 days, 25 beyond contract terms; six pain points cost $28m a year

exhibits.reader_must_see: the seven steps in order, the days and manual touch at each, and which steps carry a pain point
exhibits.comparison: each step's days and manual share today against the FY2028 target, step against step
exhibits.data: seven ordered steps, each with two day counts and two percentages, six of them with a numbered pain point

forms_considered.form: chevron process flow with an aligned metric table
forms_considered.reason: chosen: the sequence is the point, and the figures line up under the step they describe
shows hand-offs but needs four lanes the data does not use
loses the flow a director recognises at a glance

exhibits.chosen_form: chevron process flow with an aligned metric table
exhibits.why: a board member sees the cycle left to right and reads each step's figures in the column under it
exhibits.marks: numbered orange badges beside the steps that carry a pain point, keyed to the pain-point table; the Collect chevron and its 58.8 days in orange because one step holds 84% of the cycle

exhibits.reader_must_see: what each pain point is, what it costs a year and which initiative fixes it
exhibits.comparison: pain points against each other by annual cost, summing to the total
exhibits.data: six numbered pain points with evidence, a cost in $m and an initiative code, plus a total

forms_considered.form: numbered pain-point table with a total
forms_considered.reason: chosen: evidence, cost and fix read in one row and the total ties
six callouts would bury the flow under text

exhibits.chosen_form: numbered pain-point table with a total
exhibits.why: the numbers key each row to its step, and the cost column ranks them
exhibits.marks: the numbers in orange as on the flow; the largest cost, pricing errors, in bold

exhibits.reader_must_see: how much of the 70 days is contract terms and how much is avoidable, today and at target, and where the avoidable days arise
exhibits.comparison: FY2025 against FY2028 target, terms against delay
exhibits.data: two years, each split into 45 days of terms and the avoidable rest; the avoidable rest split into collection past terms and processing in the other steps

forms_considered.form: two stacked horizontal bars with a split table beneath
forms_considered.reason: chosen: the bar shows terms against avoidable delay at a glance; the table carries the split the bar cannot label at FY2028's small sizes
the FY2028 segments of 2.5 and 3.5 days are too thin to label
repeats the metric table above

exhibits.chosen_form: two stacked horizontal bars with a split table beneath
exhibits.why: the board needs the avoidable share, not the whole cycle, and the table names where the avoidable days sit
exhibits.marks: avoidable delay in orange with its days labelled; terms in a pale outlined bar, so grey keeps its one meaning of the FY2025 baseline

exhibits.reader_must_see: where the avoidable days arise, today and at target
exhibits.comparison: collection past terms against processing, FY2025 against FY2028
exhibits.data: two sources of delay over two years and their total

forms_considered.reason: chosen: FY2028's segments are too thin to label on the bar
unreadable at 2.5 and 3.5 days

exhibits.why: it names the split the bar cannot
exhibits.marks: FY2028 in bold petrol

pages.intent: the plant footprint today and after consolidation
pages.message: Two plant exits lift network utilisation from 64% to 84% and save $29m a year

exhibits.reader_must_see: where the seven plants are, which two close and where their lines move
exhibits.comparison: closing sites against receiving sites, by geography
exhibits.data: seven sites with a location, a status and three transfers between them

forms_considered.form: two inset maps, North America and Europe, with named site marks and transfer arrows
forms_considered.reason: chosen: each cluster is drawn large enough to read its transfers, with no ocean between them
tried: 40% of it was Atlantic and Canada, the clusters were tiny and the Tuttlingen arrow barely visible
shows transfers but not why the receiving plants were chosen

exhibits.chosen_form: two inset maps, North America and Europe, with named site marks and transfer arrows
exhibits.why: a director reads the footprint as a map first and the numbers key every site to its row in the table
exhibits.marks: closing sites as orange dots named in orange, with orange transfer arrows; retained sites as petrol dots named in ink; a key under the maps

exhibits.reader_must_see: each plant's capacity, utilisation and headcount now and in FY2028, with its action
exhibits.comparison: FY2025 against FY2028 per plant, and the network total
exhibits.data: seven plants by product, capacity, utilisation and headcount in two years, an action, and network totals

forms_considered.reason: chosen: the figures a director checks per site, with the total that ties
shows the rise but drops capacity and headcount

exhibits.why: utilisation rises because capacity is removed; only a table shows both together
exhibits.marks: closing rows in orange; FY2028 columns in bold petrol; the network row bold

exhibits.reader_must_see: which line moves where and when, one transfer at a time
exhibits.comparison: the three transfers against each other in time
exhibits.data: three transfers with lines, source, receiver, validation and cut-over

forms_considered.reason: chosen: five facts per transfer
the map carries where, not when

exhibits.why: the timing is the risk
exhibits.marks: closing plants in orange

exhibits.reader_must_see: what each footprint initiative saves, costs and how fast it pays back
exhibits.comparison: the three initiatives against each other and the lever total
exhibits.data: three initiatives with saving, cost and payback

forms_considered.reason: chosen: payback is a ratio a director checks
three bars carry less than the three figures

exhibits.why: it ties the title's $29m to the $68m spent
exhibits.marks: savings in bold petrol; the two exits in orange

pages.intent: which initiatives go first and which are deferred
pages.message: Four strategic bets hold 46% of the value and 64% of the cost; two quick wins start now

exhibits.reader_must_see: every initiative placed by value and ease, which quadrant it falls in, and that the strategic bets are the costly ones
exhibits.comparison: initiatives against each other on two scores, and against the two thresholds
exhibits.data: fourteen initiatives, each with a run-rate value in $m, an ease score of 1 to 5 and a cost to achieve; none sits on a threshold

forms_considered.form: 2x2 scatter with quadrant thresholds, markers sized by cost in three steps
forms_considered.reason: chosen: two scores at once, with cost read from marker size and exactly from the table
the threshold lines and quadrant names are annotations, which do not draw on a bubble chart; three marker sizes carry cost on a scatter
drops ease, which decides sequence

exhibits.chosen_form: 2x2 scatter with quadrant thresholds, markers sized by cost in three steps
exhibits.why: the quadrants are the prioritisation and the title is about cost share, so cost must be on the exhibit
exhibits.marks: threshold lines at ease 3 and $8m; quadrants named inside each corner; strategic bets in orange, other initiatives in petrol, deferred in grey; a size key

exhibits.reader_must_see: each initiative's value, cost, ease, quadrant and wave
exhibits.comparison: initiatives by lever, summing to the bridge's levers
exhibits.data: fourteen initiatives by lever with value, cost, ease and wave, and totals

forms_considered.reason: chosen: the figures behind each point, totalled to the $103m and $165m
fourteen names would collide in the dense lower right

exhibits.why: codes on the chart keep it legible and the table carries the names and figures
exhibits.marks: strategic bets' codes and quadrant in orange; other codes in petrol; the total row bold

exhibits.reader_must_see: what each dollar of EBITDA costs by lever
exhibits.comparison: levers against each other
exhibits.data: four levers with EBITDA, cost and their ratio

forms_considered.reason: chosen: a ratio per lever
four bars carry less than the ratio with its two parts

exhibits.why: it shows where the cost sits
exhibits.marks: the two levers costing over $2 per $1 in orange

pages.intent: how EBITDA gets from FY2025 to the FY2028 target, and the cash case
pages.message: Volume offsets inflation and run costs; four levers add $103m, taking EBITDA to $290m

exhibits.reader_must_see: each step from $186m to $290m, which are levers and which are headwinds, and the cost to achieve each lever
exhibits.comparison: each step's size against the others and against the start and end totals
exhibits.data: a start total, volume, two headwinds, four levers and an end total, with a cost under each lever

forms_considered.form: waterfall bridge with a cost row
forms_considered.reason: chosen: the board reads a bridge as a story from start to end and the costs sit under their levers
ties out but hides the relative size of the steps
shows phasing, which the table below carries, not the steps

exhibits.chosen_form: waterfall bridge with a cost row
exhibits.why: the claim is the sum of steps; the bridge draws it and ties it
exhibits.marks: totals in dark petrol, increases in mid petrol, decreases in warm grey; volume and the headwinds first so the levers finish the climb; an orange bracket over the four levers labelled +$103m; the cost row in petrol under the levers; a grey bracket over volume and the two headwinds labelled +$1m

exhibits.reader_must_see: how the run-rate builds year by year and when cumulative cash turns positive
exhibits.comparison: 2026, 2027 and 2028 against each other, savings against costs
exhibits.data: three years of run-rate components, EBITDA, margin, costs, working capital and cumulative cash

forms_considered.form: two year-by-year tables, EBITDA build and cash case
forms_considered.reason: chosen: figures a CFO checks, with totals
shows the crossing but drops the components

exhibits.chosen_form: two year-by-year tables, EBITDA build and cash case
exhibits.why: the audit chair recomputes the bridge and the payback from these rows
exhibits.marks: run-rate EBITDA and net cash rows bold; 2027 cumulative cash, where it turns positive, in petrol

pages.intent: when each initiative runs, its milestones and dependencies
pages.message: Seven initiatives start by April 2026; the two plant exits run back to back to June 2028

exhibits.reader_must_see: each initiative's design and delivery months, the six milestones and the three dependencies
exhibits.comparison: initiatives against each other in time, and each dependency's start against its predecessor's finish
exhibits.data: twelve initiatives with a start, a design length and a delivery length in months, six dated milestones, three dependencies

forms_considered.form: Gantt chart ordered by start, with milestone diamonds, quarter ticks and a column naming each waiting delivery
forms_considered.reason: chosen: time, overlap and sequence on one axis; a waiting delivery is named on its own row
tried: with rows ordered by start the linked rows are not adjacent, and arrows crossing other bars read as stray marks

forms_considered.form: table of start and end dates
forms_considered.reason: the reader cannot see overlap or sequence

exhibits.chosen_form: Gantt chart ordered by start, with milestone diamonds, quarter ticks and a column naming each waiting delivery
exhibits.why: a director checks that the plant exits do not overlap and that enablers land first
exhibits.marks: design phase in light petrol, delivery in petrol; milestones as orange diamonds keyed M1 to M6 with every code to the right; quarter ticks; dependencies named in orange beside the rows that wait

exhibits.reader_must_see: what each milestone means and when it falls
exhibits.comparison: milestones in date order
exhibits.data: six milestones with a code, a date and a description

forms_considered.reason: chosen: the codes on the chart are spelt out below in order
six descriptions would collide on the top row

exhibits.why: keeps the chart legible and the gates readable
exhibits.marks: codes in orange as on the diamonds

pages.intent: the new operating model and what changes in it
pages.message: Five new units and two fewer layers cut G&A from 11.6% to 9.4% of revenue

exhibits.reader_must_see: who reports to the chief executive, what sits under each, and which units are new or moved
exhibits.comparison: new and moved units against unchanged ones
exhibits.data: a chief executive, six direct reports, a staff office and fifteen units under them, each new, moved or unchanged

forms_considered.form: two-level org chart with new units marked
forms_considered.reason: chosen: reporting lines are the decision
answers who decides, not who reports to whom

forms_considered.form: before and after charts side by side
forms_considered.reason: halves the size of both on one page; the marks carry the change

exhibits.chosen_form: two-level org chart with new units marked
exhibits.why: the board approves the structure, which only a chart shows
exhibits.marks: every new unit, the CQRO's included, in a white box with an orange outline and an orange 'New'; moved units in petrol outline; connectors from each head to its units; a key under the chart

exhibits.reader_must_see: the measurable change in layers, spans, headcount and cost
exhibits.comparison: FY2025 against FY2028
exhibits.data: six measures in two years

forms_considered.reason: chosen: six figures a director checks
repeats the summary page's form

exhibits.why: compact and exact beside the governance text
exhibits.marks: FY2028 column in bold petrol; the G&A share row label bold

pages.intent: the risks to delivery and how mitigation moves them
pages.message: Mitigation brings all nine risks to ALARP or below; the two worst come from line transfers

exhibits.reader_must_see: where each risk sits before and after mitigation on likelihood and severity, and that none stays in the unacceptable zone
exhibits.comparison: each risk before against after mitigation, on one scale
exhibits.data: nine risks, each scored 1 to 5 on likelihood and severity twice

forms_considered.form: two 5x5 risk matrices side by side
forms_considered.reason: chosen: same scale and zones, so the move out of the red zone is seen at once

forms_considered.form: one matrix with arrows from before to after
forms_considered.reason: nine arrows would cross and collide
the reader must map scores to zones

exhibits.chosen_form: two 5x5 risk matrices side by side
exhibits.why: the ISO 14971 matrix is the device board's own convention, and pairing them shows the effect of mitigation
exhibits.marks: zones in mid-tone green, amber and red; one risk code per line in each cell; likelihood and severity named on the grids; a zone key

exhibits.reader_must_see: each risk, its owner, its mitigation and its scores
exhibits.comparison: risks against each other by score before and after
exhibits.data: nine risks with an owner, a mitigation and two scores

forms_considered.reason: chosen: the board minutes each owner and mitigation
nine notes would not fit beside the cells

exhibits.why: the codes tie each cell to its row
exhibits.marks: R1 and R2 codes in orange; before and after scores shaded by zone; mitigation cost per risk, $14m in all

exhibits.reader_must_see: how many risks sit in each zone before and after, and how far total exposure falls
exhibits.comparison: before against after
exhibits.data: counts in three zones and the summed score

forms_considered.reason: chosen: four rows
the counts are small integers best read as figures

exhibits.why: it states the matrices' result in figures
exhibits.marks: zone names shaded in their zone colours

exhibits.reader_must_see: what signal will warn the board before each main risk lands, and who acts
exhibits.comparison: risks against each other
exhibits.data: eight indicators with a trigger and an escalation route

forms_considered.reason: chosen: lookup content
the board needs the trigger rule, which is words

exhibits.why: it turns the register into a reporting commitment
exhibits.marks: R1 and R2 codes in orange
